question_en: Nineteen Eighty-Four, a novel by George Orwell
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o (gpt-6-sol since 2026-10-01) through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
comment: FASTAPI-TEXT2SQL-339. A book title plus its author must resolve to the work's own source-work fiche (Nineteen Eighty-Four, ID_SOURCE_WORK 7358, Wikidata Q208460), never to the homonymous film (the title alone returns the movie 1984). This is the resolvable text that the vision fix now composes from a photo of the book; the harness is text-only and cannot upload an image, so this evaluation guards the downstream resolution the vision pre-stage depends on, not the vision prompt itself. The assertion targets what was missing, a source-work result, by the stable catalogue id rather than by the title, which a base refresh could re-label.
